That evening he launched the bottle again, adding a line of his own: the sea returns what it cannot keep.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台刚刚降低转速的机器，霓虹还亮着，却没了喧哗。便利店的白光落在空荡路口，环卫车缓慢驶过，水花擦亮柏油。高楼间悬着薄雾，远处天际线泛起一线灰蓝。外卖员靠在电动车旁打盹，夜班护士推开玻璃门，面包房第一炉香气悄悄溢出。此刻没人催促时间，连红绿灯都显得温柔，仿佛城市在醒来前，终于允许自己做了一个短梦。","w03":"- Recursion is when a thing explains itself by using a smaller version of itself.\n- Like standing between two mirrors: each reflection shows a smaller reflection, until it is too tiny to see.\n- A function can call itself to solve a big problem by solving little pieces, then stopping at the simplest case."}
